question: Should this combined dependency and workflow refresh land as one PR after final CI, or should the workflow action refresh be split from the runtime/package updates?
rationale: The diff is coherent and no blocking defect was found, but it changes release and automation surfaces that PR checks cannot fully exercise.

options.title: Land after final CI
options.body: Proceed with the combined refresh once all required checks on the exact head are green, relying on the verified action SHAs and PR proof.

options.title: Split workflow pins
options.body: Ask for a narrower follow-up that separates GitHub Actions pin updates from Go, Docker, and worker dependency updates to reduce release automation review scope.

options.title: Hold for release-path proof
options.body: Pause until maintainers run or inspect additional release, Pages, or post-release workflow proof beyond normal PR checks.

recommendation.body: Proceed with the combined refresh once all required checks on the exact head are green, relying on the verified action SHAs and PR proof.
